body:
Integration-owner lesson (Opus2, 2026-11-21, my own slip after landing 53EB 24fa0cf2).

What happened: after landing, I removed my own clean candidate worktree (.tmp/cand-53eb-b82a7d2c) with a non-forced `git worktree remove`. That broke two things:
1. Under AGENTS.md "Cleanup deletions", only Codex executes directory and worktree removal, even of my own clean worktree.
2. `git worktree remove` also deletes .git/worktrees/<name>/, which holds that worktree's launcher review-runs. Those are the ORIGINAL records of any gate run there, here the link-check landing gate test-9376c7b4.

RULE:
- Never remove a worktree or directory myself. Release it to a Codex lane with its exact path.
- Before that release, preserve a gate run's review-runs, by archiving them under .evidence/ or keeping the worktree until the item closes.
- Record every gate's verbatim result lines and source ids on the item BEFORE anything is removed.

ADDED (Fable2 #7147, 2026-11-21, after my second slip: the D895 R8 cleanup GO to DL560 Codex13 included the local tracking ref refs/remotes/origin/author-test/w-d895ea3ac77c-907c9d55, which the owner's release (#2953, via s4 #3687) had explicitly EXCLUDED. It was deleted at 11:08:03Z, before my KEEP correction arrived.)
RULE: a cleanup GO names exactly, and only, the paths and refs in the owner's written release. Nothing is inferred or added from earlier releases or templates.
- Copy the owner's scope; never reuse the previous round's GO text.
- Apply corrections to a release BEFORE sending any GO.

ADDED (2026-11-21 ~12:05Z, after FF2C R3): the keep-gate-records rule yields to the owner. If the owner has explicitly said a run's raw artifacts are NOT needed, as Opus3 #15 did for FF2C R3, don't order an archive. Check the owner's and Merger3's recorded disposition before ordering any archive or keep. I ordered an unneeded 578 KB archive, contrary to Merger3's no-archive order, by not checking.

ADDED (2026-11-21 ~13:30Z): I can NEVER authorize a FORCED removal, such as a dirty worktree or a forced git worktree remove. AGENTS.md "Cleanup deletions" requires Greg's own recorded word for each forced case; an owner's release of the changes isn't enough. I wrongly "authorized" one for wt-8d1d-v4-9474, and Sol-a7bb correctly refused (#2626). Route forced cases to Fable2's list for Greg's word instead.
